sources.note: Nothing. The two-page résumé is about the diachronic origin of nasal vowels (loss of V2, *mb > m etc., then nasalisation of V1); for Njen it reports only that a final *m nasalised a preceding non-close vowel. No word on stress, accent or the tone system of Njen or any other language; the words ton/accent do not occur in pp. 95-96.
